text:
elaine: Heads-up — FinServe onboarding tomorrow. Main asks: SOC2 readiness checklist, immutable per-tenant audit logs, BYOK (HSM/KMS), and tenant-level data retention controls.

michael: Noted. Do we have an agreed SLA or retention windows from them?

elaine: They mentioned 7 years for some records and shorter for derivatives. SLA: audit log access within 24h and exportable logs for e-discovery.

raj: Legal will need proof points for data residency + export controls. Also need key escrow terms if we support BYOK.

michael: Implementation notes: per-tenant immutable logs implies write-once storage + append-only index. That has cost + perf implications. Could be an opt-in add-on.

elaine: Can we scope an MVP: (1) exportable audit log export (S3-compatible), (2) retention policy config per tenant, (3) BYOK prototype via KMS integration in private clouds?

michael: MVP sounds reasonable. For BYOK prototype we can integrate with cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) first, HSM later. Needs KMS key rotation UX and clear threat model.

raj: For SOC2 evidence, we'll need: policy docs, controls mapping, and config that proves retention and access logs are enabled per tenant. I can draft the mapping if we lock features.

elaine: Launch criteria proposal: automated export + searchability, tenant retention UI/API, BYOK basic integration, and SOC2 control mapping doc. If any of those are missing, flag as beta.

michael: Dependencies: storage encryption at rest (already done), longer retention tier storage, export job runner, and RBAC changes for log visibility. Also need tracing around who requested exports.

deploy-bot: Reminder: last infra maintenance window 1792509000 — will block large migrations during that period.

elaine: Timeline ask from sales: pilot in 6 weeks. That's tight. Suggest ship export + retention UI in 6 weeks, BYOK prototype in next sprint (additional 4 weeks).

michael: I can commit to export + retention UI in 6 weeks if we scope it to: retention config (days), export endpoint, and retention enforcement job. Example config:
```
retention_policy: 
  tenant_id: fs-123
  retention_days: 365
  archive_to: s3://redwood-archives/fs-123
```

sophia: From CS: FinServe is high-touch, willing to be pilot customer and help with testing. They expect contract clause around key escrow options.

raj: Will draft the contract addendum for BYOK options and data residency. Send me the exact KMS flows once sketched.

elaine: Okay next actions: Michael to write RFC with proposed MVP scope + infra impacts, Raj to start contract addendum draft, Sophia to confirm pilot terms, and I'll add work to roadmap and sync with sales.

michael: I'll drop an RFC PR by EOD tomorrow, will include migration risk, cost estimate, and rough UI wireframes.

elaine: Thanks — tagging this for next roadmap sync. :thumbsup:
